evals.prompt: I want to build a CLI tool that helps developers manage their .env files across multiple environments (dev, staging, prod). Right now I just manually copy-paste and it's error-prone. Can you help me write a PRD for this?
evals.expected_output: Should conduct a conversational interview asking about target users, supported environments, encryption needs, team collaboration, then generate a PRD to docs/prd.md

evals.prompt: We need a feature for our existing app — a notification system that can send emails and push notifications when certain events happen. Help me define the requirements.
evals.expected_output: Should explore what events trigger notifications, who receives them, delivery channels, frequency/batching, then research codebase for integration points and generate PRD

evals.prompt: I have this idea for a browser extension that highlights AI-generated text on any webpage. Not sure if it's feasible. Can we scope this out?
evals.expected_output: Should probe feasibility, detection approach, supported browsers, privacy concerns, do web research on AI detection techniques, then generate a realistic PRD acknowledging technical limitations
